children: British police will carry out a criminal investigation into allegations that the populist Reform UK party, led by Nigel Farage, breached donation rules, a Times reporter said, after its officials were filmed by undercover reporters.

Times reporter Fiona Hamilton posting on X on Wednesday quoted London's Metropolitan Police as saying: "Detectives have assessed the information provided and determined that there are potential offences requiring investigation."
